escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: A budget calculator can count invoice forecast or invoice payment cash transactions as uncategorized expense while also retaining the underlying card purchase, producing a plausible but double-counted projected budget.

literal_case.procedure: Model the real cards-core distinction: forecast/payment have invoiceId, cardId and accountId; the economic card purchase has invoiceId/cardId without accountId. Run the budget dashboard regression on exact head.
literal_case.expected: Forecast and payment contribute zero to realized/committed and Sem categoria, while the purchase remains budget consumption.
literal_case.observed: excludesInvoiceCashMovementsFromBudgetConsumption passes on exact-head CI 36191538438; current material head is 10dc5230eaca80c23cbe2f29ab062beaebef4854.

prevention_change.evidence: budget-operations.ts rejects invoice cash transactions at category discovery, realized collection and committed collection while preserving economic purchases.

detection_change.evidence: A discriminating domain regression uses the same structural fields as cards-core forecast/payment and proves downstream absence from budget consumption.

escapes.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat the existence of any overlapping budget for a category and currency as coverage for the whole dashboard interval, causing consumption outside the actual budget dates to disappear instead of remaining unbudgeted.

literal_case.procedure: Query a full-month dashboard with two partial budgets for the same category/currency and place realized and committed items before, inside, between and after those budget windows.
literal_case.expected: Items inside an exact budget window remain budgeted; items before, between and after the windows remain visible as unbudgeted using occurredOn for realized and plannedOn for committed.
literal_case.observed: keepsConsumptionOutsidePartialBudgetWindowsAsUnbudgeted passes on exact-head CI 36191538438; current material head is 10dc5230eaca80c23cbe2f29ab062beaebef4854.

prevention_change.evidence: budget-operations.ts now decides coverage for each consumption item by comparing its economic date to exact active budget periods for the same category and currency.

detection_change.evidence: The domain regression exercises before, inside, gap, inside and after positions for both realized and committed consumption.
